notes.title: 9-Bit Armies in Full Release!
notes.notes:
Exciting News: 9-Bit Armies: A Bit Too Far is Now Fully Released on PC!

We are thrilled to announce the full release of 9-Bit Armies, now available on PC! Dive into a fast-paced, retro-style real-time strategy (RTS) game that brings pixel-perfect mayhem to your screen. In 9-Bit Armies, you’ll command an army of blocky units, building bases, gathering resources, and unleashing chaos on your opponents. Whether you’re new to the RTS genre or a veteran strategist, the accessible controls and streamlined mechanics ensure that everyone can jump into the fun, while the depth of the gameplay will keep you coming back for more.

The game features a wide variety of game modes to suit all types of players. Solo players can enjoy a campaign filled with intense battles and challenging AI opponents, while multiplayer enthusiasts will relish the chance to take on friends and foes alike in online skirmishes. With the ability to customize armies and choose from a range of units—from infantry and tanks to powerful air strikes—each match feels unique and full of strategic possibilities. Plus, the destructible environments add an extra layer of tactical depth, allowing you to carve your own path to victory.

One of the most exciting aspects of 9-Bit Armies is its nostalgic 8-bit inspired art style blended with modern gameplay. The vibrant, blocky graphics bring a delightful retro charm to each battlefield, while the energetic soundtrack keeps the adrenaline pumping during every clash. Whether you’re building your base from scratch or leading an all-out assault, 9-Bit Armies delivers fast, fun, and frantic gameplay that will keep you hooked. Grab your copy today and lead your blocky battalion to victory!

notes.title: 8-Bit Invaders Community Update - 14th November 2023
notes.notes:
[i]Kick the tires and light the fires![/i] 

We are excited to announce a new set of updates for our 8-Bit series of RTS games (8-Bit Armies, 8-Bit Hordes, 8-Bit Invaders) out now. With feedback from the community we have hunted down bugs, tuned things up and even the virtuoso Frank Klepacki has provided three new music tracks which you can experience in-game as well as in the soundtrack DLC.

Some of the standout changes we have made include fixing up the exploit that allowed players to see when a resource node was being used. Some changes to the Gremlin and Heavy Drone. As well as several fixes that should smooth out the remaining hiccups some players were experiencing.

Check out the changelog below for details:

[h1]Music[/h1][h2]New Tracks[/h2]	- "8-Bit Funk" - (Armies)
	- "Sorcerer's Ambush" - (Hordes)
	- "Bug Hunt" - (Invaders)

[h1]UI[/h1]- Replaced News Cranioid with more current news about new game (9-Bit Armies!) coming out.
- Updated leaderboard links to include only those that are actively supported.

[h1]Balance[/h1]- Gremlin (Marines):
	- Area-effect radius of heal doubled to 100 (was 50).

- Heavy Drone (Guardians):
	- MG weapon casting seconds reduced to 0 (was 0.3)
	- Reduced damage per shot to 2 (was 3)
	- These changes together increase base DPS for MG weapon to 10 (was 6)
	- Rocket weapon cooldown reduced to 2.2 seconds (was 2.7)
	- Rocket base damage increased to 6 (was 5)
	- These changes together increase base DPS for Rocket weapon to 7.27 (was 5.26)

[h1]Bug/Exploit Fixes[/h1]- Improved/Fixed very long startup and load times that could occur randomly.
- Fixed a bug that automatically selected the Intel integrated graphics over an Nvidia device on some laptops.
- Fixed a rendering slowdown related to particles.
- Fixed a crash that could happen following a large number of weapon impacts on terrain.
- Fixing issue in which Hordes harvester was misnamed in German and was also using French translation.
- Fixed bug in which the Orbital Cannon superweapon alarm is repeated continuously if destroyed just before firing.
- Fixed hard-coded text in the tooltips for Units and Structures which appeared in English no matter which language was selected.
- Fixed animation issue around resource nodes. Resource nodes will no longer animate (giving away harvester locations) when under fog of war.

notes.title: 8-Bit Invaders Update #21 - 10/06/20
notes.notes:
We're back with a new update for the game!
 
Over the last couple years we've been making improvements to our core RTS engine tech which has resulted in fixing a number of long-standing issues.  With your help, we've retroactively applied those fixes to our 8-Bit Series which means a new update for you!  As an added bonus, a new song has been added to each game which you can hear in-game and also separately if you own the soundtrack.  And, we have made the game more Linux-friendly to boot!   
The full list of changes include...
[list]
[*] Three new music tracks added (one each for 8-Bit Armies, 8-Bit Hordes, and 8-Bit Invaders) Those songs are:
[*] * Click Move Attack (8-Bit Armies)
[*] * Bonded Allies (8-Bit Hordes)
[*] * Raygun Scatter (8-Bit Invaders)
[*] Reduced crashes seen at main menu when framerate is set abnormally high in software.
[*] Fixed occasional issue of radar map expanding and obscuring half the screen.
[*] Fixed errant call to offline resource which would delay launch of game.
[*] Modifications to numbering system visuals that affected players using emulators (Wine) in Linux.  Numbers will now display normally.
[*] Improved framerate on some systems by disabling memory state cache.
[*] Added support to allow ESC'ing out of the end of match debrief screen.
[*] Input Method Editor (IME) support for Chinese language added.
[*] Fixed script so the replay delete actually works now.
[*] Numerous Crash fixes and library updates that were discovered and implemented for other Petroglyph titles which have been ported over to the 8-Bit Series to improve general stability and compatibility.
[/list]

We hope you like it.   Thanks for your continued support!
 
-8Bit

notes.title: 8-Bit Invaders Update #19 - 03/21/2019
notes.notes:
Hey gamers!  
 
We’ve been storing up a bunch of minor fixes and performance improvements to the 8-Bit Series of games over the last few months based on your feedback and some things we've found ourselves.  In general, the game should be more stable, run even faster, use a little less ram, and make multiplayer gaming a little more solid.   We hope you enjoy the new update and please let us know if you run into anything we should know about.
 
As always, we appreciate your support.  ːsteamhappyː
 
-8Bit
 
[h1]GENERAL BUG FIXES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for jump jet infantry being order-locked when a save then load is performed while they are mid-flight.
[*]Added a map validation check that looks for too many stacked structures and warns the user of such on save.
[*]Fix for crashing when pressing shift while the instance tab is active (in the terrain editor).
[*]Adding a warning message on save that displays if resource nodes are found near any start markers (can potentially break the AI by placing resource nodes around the starting points).
[*]Limiting playable bounds setting to 11 and above when creating a new map with the public terrain editor.
[*]Fixed a case of the camera constraint function oscillating between two values when the playable bounds is small in the map editor.
[*]Fix for replanning failing when the target area is covered by too much stuff (movement failed to reach clicked destination despite there being a path to get there).
[*]Optimization attempt #2 at reducing CPU load when pruning producing objects (server could run slow when a lot of units are queued up and buildings are being destroyed).
[*]General Save/Load fixes to handle rare cases where continuing a battle would not work properly.
[*]Timeout a lobby join after 10 seconds so that players don’t hang forever waiting to join.
[*]General bug fixes to AI to optimize performance and handle a few strategic situations better.
[*]Correction to allow for correct country code to be set when quickmatching.
[*]Various back-end improvements for performance and frame-rate.
[*]Improved data transmission between server and client
[*]Fix for soft-lock when someone disconnects before joining a multiplayer game.
[*]Fix for showing weapon FX under unexplored fog of war which would reveal other player’s weaponry and location of battle.
[*]Player names in lobby should update a little more frequently.
[*]Steam “Played with Users” should be updated now.
[*]Handled an issue where some custom maps could fail to launch in Multiplayer.
[*]Fix for getting disconnected when connecting to an instance if the instance takes a long time to load.  For example, when downloading a custom map for the first time.
[*]Fix for not being able to launch a multiplayer game with everyone is assigned to a random team.
[*]Prevent players having blank multiplayer game names.
[*]Fixed three separate issues which would have manifested itself to players as a “random crash”.
[*]Battlecam tweaks to improve angles and identify the highest priority events.
[*]Fix for flickering load screen on some systems.
[*]Re-enabled Anti-Aliasing on ATI cards.   Also, removed AA slider if AA isn’t available.
[*]Improved memory usage.  Game optimized to use less.
[/list]

notes.title: 8-Bit Invaders Game Update #15 - 07/25/17 @ 13:30 (PST)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We continue to monitor our multiplayer statics and read through the forums to determine if there are any corrections that need to be made to balance or the game in general.  Thanks to you, we've identified a number of small tweaks that needed to be made - especially to Regent mode in multiplayer.

Have fun!

[h1]PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
GENERAL:
[list]
[*]Added new armor type "Neutral" to game. This will not show up in the GUI listing since it is only used for the Regents in Assassination mode. Neutral armor removes all damage modifiers from weapons - the target will take the weapon's base damage from attacks.
[*]The Regent unit for all factions (used in Assassination Mode) have been updated to use Neutral Armor.
[*]Shortened a variety of non-english texts to fit properly within the UI
[/list]

[list]
[*]Cannon Turret (Guardians): Damage type changed to Neutral, Base damage increased to 20 (was 15), Shot speed slowed to 1.5 (was 1.0), Can now target aircraft
[*]Wraith (Deathsworn): The heal effect was not stacking to 3 as intended (like all other healers) - this has been fixed, Heal aura increased to 300 radius (was 250) to match skeleton conversion effect radius, Build cost reduced to 140 (was 160).
[*]Ballista (Lightbringers): Line of attack widened slightly; damage remains the same, but it should be easier to hit with it.
[*]Phoenix (Lightbringers): Base damage reduced to 14 (was 16), AoE radius of shots reduced to 30 (was 50).
[/list]

notes.notes:
Hey guys and gals - we've got more balance tweaks today as well as a highly requested feature we're getting in for your weekend today.

For the month of February all our games will be on sale at some point (Armies, Hordes, and Invaders).  If you've been looking to purchase another game or want to complete the collection - this is the month to do it.  And if you buy the entire series, you'll get a discount for the game you already own and get an EXTRA discount for the package.

We hope you enjoy all the stuff we will be releasing in February!

notes.title: 8-Bit Invaders Game Update #3 - 01/06/17
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!  ːsteamhappyː

After a few quick fixes for 8-Bit Invaders immediately after release we're now focusing on the bigger picture related to balance and functionality changes that you've made us aware of.

In terms of fixes, we're really happy with everything we've knocked out in the last few days and we're excited to have you try out these latest changes. 

Give it a look, and let us know if we missed anything!

-8Bit

[B]GAME FIXES / IMPROVEMENTS:[/B]
[list]
[*]The tooltip for the Gorgon no longer incorrectly states that it can crush.
[*]The radar blip for Invaders harvesters has been increased in size such that you can see them underneath the resource point icons. This is a temporary fix until we can replace it with a more aesthetically pleasing fix.
[*]Fixed issue with Hordes and Invaders harvesters where crushable units would run away from them even though they can't crush. This general only happens when playing against a Hard or Insane AI.
[*]Fixed passability issue on Orc-Jaw Ford map causing harvesters to be unable to dock at some resource nodes.
[*]The Destroyer pit tooltip no longer says it needs power.
[*]Potential fix for allied AI not respecting the factions 1-4 resource node "tap" mechanic, also system should not assign initial harvesters to a node more than once.
[*]The allied harvester resource node "tagging" duration has been increased, which should prevent Invaders factions from stealing from their allies.  Armies harvesters increased to 30 seconds (was 20); Hordes harvesters increased to 20 seconds (was 10).
[*]Battlecam hotkey should not work while in Metaverse overworld.
[*]Fix for dragging units in meta mode over the garrison structures, which would cause the drag icon to be placed over the unit icon, which would then cause the unit icon to not be draggable anymore.
[*]The Guardians Drone Center and Scorch tank are no longer pointing to the Renegades tech building for their tooltips.
[*]Fix for Earth Seige Co-op Mission so doesn't display a count of how many titan bays were destroyed (titan bays are only tracked for Gold Star Visual).
[*]Fixes that allows Achievement "Hexes are the Future" to be completed.
[*]Improved game stability.
[/list]

[B]BALANCE[/B]
[list]
[*]Blast Bug: Min range increased to 250 (was 200), Shot cooldown increased to 3.2 (was 2.2); this reduces DPS to 5.14 (was 7.2). Change was made to both ground and air attacks.
[*]Xeno Dog: Melee range increased slightly to aid in attacking larger objects, Base damage of acid pool reduced to 8 (was 12)
[*]Invaders Harvesters: Health reduced to 350 (was 500), Move speed reduced to 200 (was 250).
[*]Titan: The armor type on the Titan was incorrect (Light).  It has been changed to Heavy, which was always intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Timing News about 8-Bit Invaders!
notes.notes:
Hey Players!

First, we would like to thank everyone for your AWESOME support since the release of 8-Bit Armies back in April. Since launch, we’ve updated our first 8-Bit game [b]26 times[/b] using the feedback that you have shared with us - and we have no intention of stopping support now. 8-Bit Hordes has also received a half-dozen updates over the last couple months since launch and we have more planned for the future that we’re eager to release.

As you all know, our third game 8-Bit Invaders! is a sci-fi angle on RTS using the same fun blocky art style from the series.  Our goal is to continue introducing the real-time strategy genre to a new audience and grow the total number of players online by making all three games compatible while keeping the gameplay accessible and easy to learn.   With the third game, we’re also introducing a new campaign mode that allows players to persist their army across multiple worlds and think a little more strategically about what their next move should be. 

While development of this new feature is coming along great (it’s already playable) – we also want to make sure we get it right. Since this is something very new and somewhat experimental, we’re spending extra time building a challenging AI to play against and integrating various modifiers like territory bonuses at the galactic level.   We also want to make sure features like save/load are in and working, since this is a game mode that will likely take longer to play than just one sitting.

As much as we want to get it into your hands soon, we’re going to take a little while longer so we have enough time for tweaking, and any further polish work that needs to happen. Because of this, we will be delaying the launch of Invaders until December. Our hope is to share some screenshots of this new game mode in the next few weeks so you can get a better idea of how it’s going to play. And  course, we’ll be looking for some beta testers before launch so that we can make sure everything is balanced as well as it can be.  We’ll let you know the exact date of the beta as we get closer to launch.

Finally, we mentioned above that your feedback has been invaluable in helping us decide what to focus on in our game updates. We’re still listening!

Due to popular demand, on November 11th we’ll be releasing a Unit Voice Pack DLC for 8-Bit Hordes which adds verbal responses for both the LightBringers and Deathsworn factions.   These new voices recorded with professional actors and actresses add a lot of character to the game and we can’t wait for you to hear them. Best of all, we’re making this DLC available for the heavily discounted price of [b]FREE![/b]  Even better, a Unit Voice Pack for 8-Bit Armies is also on the horizon to be released later.

Once again, we appreciate your support and the great feedback we’ve received through your reviews of the game. It’s really energizing for us to read through your comments and discuss what’s next for the future of the 8-Bit series. We couldn’t do it without you!

Thanks,

-8Bit
